// Reference code (not production): generated from Figma "Brownfield Design" > Library - Music by tools/screen_code.py.

import androidx.compose.foundation.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.*
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource

@Composable
fun LibraryMusicScreen(navigate: (String) -> Unit) {
    Scaffold(
        bottomBar = {
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                MiniPlayer(
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1180_10_451),
                    title = "لو كنت غالى",
                    subtitle = "مصطفى قمر",
                    onOpen = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(AppTheme.spacing.spacing4))
                BottomNavigation(
                    firstItem = NavigationItem(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.explore),
                        icon = AppIcons.Explore,
                    ),
                    secondItem = NavigationItem(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.search),
                        icon = AppIcons.Search,
                    ),
                    thirdItem = NavigationItem(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.connect),
                        icon = AppIcons.Groups,
                    ),
                    fourthItem = NavigationItem(
                        selected = true,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.your_library),
                        icon = AppIcons.LibraryMusic,
                    ),
                    onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("explore-viewport"); 1 -> navigate("search-discover-viewport"); 3 -> navigate("library-music") } },
                )
            }
        },
    ) { innerPadding ->
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(innerPadding)
                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
        ) {
            StatusBar(time = "5:00", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
            // Search Section
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing12),
            ) {
                SearchBar(
                    placeholder = stringResource(R.string.search_in_your_library),
                    iconSearch = AppIcons.Search,
                    iconMic = AppIcons.Mic,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // Library Tabs
            Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                // Tabs Row
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    PrimaryTabs(
                        firstTab = TabItem(selected = true, label = stringResource(R.string.music)),
                        secondTab = TabItem(label = stringResource(R.string.podcasts_caps)),
                        onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("library-music"); 1 -> navigate("library-podcasts") } },
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(AppTheme.spacing.spacing12))
                    IconButton(icon = AppIcons.Settings)
                    IconButton(icon = AppIcons.Help)
                }
                Divider(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
            }
            // Filter Chips
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                FilterChip(selected = true, label = stringResource(R.string.playlists))
                FilterChip(label = stringResource(R.string.albums))
                FilterChip(label = stringResource(R.string.artists))
            }
            // Shortcut Tiles
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                LibraryShortcutTile(
                    label = stringResource(R.string.likes),
                    icon = AppIcons.Favorite,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                )
                LibraryShortcutTile(
                    color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Cyan,
                    label = stringResource(R.string.downloads),
                    icon = AppIcons.CloudDownload,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                )
                LibraryShortcutTile(
                    color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Magenta,
                    label = stringResource(R.string.created_for_you),
                    icon = AppIcons.Album,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                )
                LibraryShortcutTile(
                    color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Yellow,
                    label = stringResource(R.string.your_uploads),
                    icon = AppIcons.Upload,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                )
            }
            // Playlists Header
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                ListHeader(
                    title = stringResource(R.string.playlists),
                    showAction = true,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // Playlists
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1367_10_391),
                    title = "Arabic Music Mix",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_469_songs_by_you),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1385_10_391),
                    title = stringResource(R.string.music_mix),
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_541_songs_by_you),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1396_10_391),
                    title = "Farah",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_46_songs_by_nourhan_bahey),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1407_10_391),
                    title = "Amr diab",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_101_songs_by_you),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1418_10_391),
                    title = "Fayrouz",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_28_songs_by_you),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1429_10_391),
                    title = "Massar Egbari - Maba'etsh Aktar",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_10_songs_by_you),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1440_10_391),
                    title = "نجوم تغنى كوكب الشرق",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_36_songs),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                PlaylistListItem(
                    showMore = true,
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1451_10_391),
                    title = "Music & OST",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.t_105_songs_by_you),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
        }
    }
